title: Fences
description: Visible and invisible boundaries surround us from birth to death and each of us handles these social dividing lines differently – while some break through to the other side, others fall at the first hurdle. This animation cleverly explores the barriers we construct between us and how we respond to them in our daily lives.
producers: Polish National Film School in Łódź Animation Natalia Krawczuk A sudden meeting of a Man and a Woman begins a hypnotic act of pleasure and discomfort. They slowly get closer to each other in a game of mutual seduction and unclothing. III is a portrait of a woman staying in an uneasy and exhausting relationship with a man
which allures her and repulses her at the same time.
